notes.title: Game Fix 1.17
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.17[/b]

1. Added machine localization to :
[b]Turkish[/b]
[b]Polish[/b]

2. Fixed a bug with falling through the floor for some players, added additional blocks.

3. Changing the damage screen.
 ( for a more convenient overview of the player )
Added 50% transparency and display sequence.

4. Added hints on the use of items in different places of passage. ( pills, books )

5. Added infinite spawn of books, on the 1st floor, when the book misses the lever.

6. Added a block when falling out of the ventilation in the kitchen 
(now, when descending from the ventilation, the character simply rolls past the table).

7. Added hidden locations for 2 future free DLC

notes.title: Some simple fixes.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed a bug due to which some might not play sounds as they progress.
[/list]
[list]
[*] the principle of operation of lamps in the library has been changed, as some users have encountered problems in which even with the correct combination, the door would not open.
[/list]
[list]
[*] the localization of the Korean and Spanish languages was fixed, because of which the fuse was not inserted.
[/list]
[list]
[*] added additional sounds at the time of passing the warehouse and dining room.
[/list]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug that caused the monster to not appear in the basement.
[/list]
[list]
[*] added additional books on the second floor.
[/list]
